Cc: samir@talentfirm.com
Date: Thu, 9 Aug 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Virtual onsite: proposed multi-slot + panel mapping (Priya N.)

Hi all —

Thanks for moving quickly on Priya's loop. Candidate is excited and has confirmed she can do either next week or the week after in the 9am–1pm PT window. Draft agenda attached (panel_schedule_v3.ics) and a compact loop matrix (loop_matrix_v2.csv).

High-level propose: three 50-minute technical panels (system design, inference/runtime, product-ML), one 30-minute collaboration/culture interview, and a 30-minute hiring manager wrap. Total ~4 hours with a 20-minute buffer for overruns.

I mapped primary interviewers in the matrix; below are a few notes and asks:
- Please confirm your primary/backup slots (we need immediate backups for the two technical panels)
- Laura: could you advise on swapping an interviewer to increase panel diversity (vertical experience + cross-team perspective)?
- Marissa: can you issue the calendar invites once we lock times and attach the resume?

Attachments: PriyaNatarajan_Resume.pdf, panel_schedule_v3.ics, loop_matrix_v2.csv

Thanks,
Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Recruiting Partner | Redwood Inference

Also, happy to share a short homework PDF if helpful for the product-ML interview; just let me know format.

Best,

Thanks for the draft — a couple of suggestions:

1) Panel diversity: for the system design panel I'd prefer we swap in an interviewer with infrastructure inference experience rather than two product engineers. Can Logan or Marcus confirm availability?

2) Backup interviewer cadence: let's assign one backup per panel and a rotational "floater" (30m) who can jump in if a paneler has to drop — I can take the floater slot on Aug 22 afternoon.

3) Candidate needs: Priya mentioned a noon hard stop on Aug 23 — can we compress the Aug 23 day to two 60-minute sessions (inference/runtime + hiring manager) to respect that?

If everyone agrees I'll update the loop_matrix_v2.csv with the swap and send a final invite.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product | Redwood Inference

Thanks team — quick confirmations and an explicit contingency plan: 

1) I can cover inference/runtime on Aug 22 at 10:30 PT (confirmed). Karthik is a solid backup if something changes.

2) Laura — I support swapping Marcus out for a more infra-focused interviewer. Marcus, could you take the backup role and we’ll invite Anika Shah from Platform as the primary? Anika is cc'd below (I will add her in the calendar).

3) Contingency: if any primary drops within 24 hours we will escalate to the backup; if a two-person panel loses >1 primary, the floater will join. Marissa — please include a short "contingency" note on each invite so external participants understand potential minor re-sequencing.

4) Timing for Priya: compressing Aug 23 to two 60-minute sessions is fine — we'll move inference/runtime and hiring manager to 9:00 and 10:10 PT respectively to honor the noon hard stop.

Marissa — once you push final invites I will run a quick pre-brief in Slack with the panel (10 minutes) and share a short rubric.

Best,
Logan Wright
Staff SWE, Inference Runtime | Redwood Inference
